specName: Repository Profiles for the C#/XAML Dependency Graph
request:
I want to simplify how the extension c# xaml Dependency graph works.  insetad of having 1 file for all patterens for different repos I want each repo to initialize a profile using ai chat. ask ?s before starting, use your repsonse instructions

continue, note that i just created a new branch so you will be able to compare builds at the end, set this ups as /speckit-companion-classify

continue, note there should also be a buttoon in the ui to tell the ai agent to update the profile by looking for new patterns
expectations: A separate profile per project inside one workspace folder; the profile scope is the workspace folder.
A shared or published registry of profiles, or profiles shipped with the extension.
Generating conventions without an assistant; there is no heuristic auto-detector.
Changes to how the graph looks, how it is laid out, or what it draws beyond what the profile corrects.
Languages other than C# and XAML.
Per-person profiles; the profile is shared through the repository.
Editing the profile through a settings form rather than as a file.
context: area: extensions/csharp-xaml-graph/src/graph/layers.ts - hardcoded service, view-model and data name suffixes and prefixes, namespace segments, and the precedence between them
area: extensions/csharp-xaml-graph/src/graph/analyze.ts - link detection: Add* registration calls, DependencyProperty.Register, DataContext and binding conventions, VIEW_ROOT_KIND view roots
area: extensions/csharp-xaml-graph/src/graph/findings.ts - TRANSPARENT_BASES, ENTRY_POINT_NAMES, generatedMembers from RelayCommand and ObservableProperty, unused-type rules
area: extensions/csharp-xaml-graph/src/extension.ts - file discovery through csharpXamlGraph.include and exclude, DEFAULT_EXCLUDE, cached model and ANALYSIS_KEYS invalidation
area: extensions/csharp-xaml-graph/src/webview/html.ts with client/main.ts - graph toolbar already carries Re-analyse and Export JSON buttons; the profile control belongs there
area: extensions/csharp-xaml-graph/src/menu - sidebar panel forwards every action to a contributed command; new commands are declared in package.json contributes.commands
constraint: no Copilot Chat or language-model integration exists in the extension today; no workbench.action.chat or vscode.lm usage anywhere in src, so chat initialization is new capability
constraint: extension tests already assert command registration, toolbar markup and settings behaviour, so current behaviour must survive the change

FR-001.title: The extension reads a repository's conventions from a profile stored in that repository, one profile per workspace folder

FR-002.title: The profile declares layer classification: name suffixes, name prefixes, namespace segments, and the precedence between them
tests: test/graph/conventions.test.ts::the built-in rule list keeps todays classification; test/graph/layers.test.ts::classifyType: a profiles own rules

FR-003.title: The profile declares link detection: registration call names and the conventions by which markup binds to a view model

FR-004.title: The profile declares findings rules: entry points, transparent base types, and generated members
tests: test/graph/findings.unused.test.ts::computeFindings: a profiles findings rules; test/graph/findings.bindings.test.ts::members a profile says are generated

FR-005.title: The profile declares which files are read and which are excluded

FR-006.title: Built-in conventions fall back for anything undeclared, and no profile behaves exactly as today
tests: test/graph/analyze.test.ts::produces the same graph for a built-in profile as for no profile at all; selftest 1095/4776/21

FR-007.title: An initialization action opens AI chat with a setup prompt that asks its questions before proposing any answer

FR-008.title: The setup prompt carries repository evidence for each question it asks

FR-009.title: The assistant's reply is imported and written as plain, human-readable text a person can review and commit

FR-010.title: The import refuses an unusable reply, writes nothing, and names what was missing
tests: test/extension.test.ts::refuses a reply it cannot use and writes nothing; ::importing a reply that records nothing

FR-011.title: The graph offers a control that asks the agent to find conventions the profile does not yet cover
FR-011.assumes: the panel forwards the profile message and the command opens chat; the chat itself is stubbed in tests

FR-012.title: Applying a profile re-reads the repository without an editor restart

FR-013.title: An unreadable, malformed or partial profile never blocks the graph; what can be read applies, and what could not is reported
tests: test/graph/profileFallback.test.ts; test/webview/profileProblems.test.ts; test/webview/main.test.ts::the profile control and the profile notice

FR-014.title: A repository with no profile is offered creation once per session, dismissibly, without blocking

FR-015.title: An explicitly configured file pattern keeps taking effect and wins over the profile's file selection

FR-016.title: Refreshing a profile preserves every declaration it holds: it adds or corrects, never silently drops
tests: test/graph/profile.test.ts::mergeProfile; test/extension.test.ts::says what an existing file could not carry over

FR-030.assumes: the record producer is exercised by running it; src/validate.ts is a command entry point excluded from coverage, so --expected is proven by its output (T089, T097) rather than by a unit test

tests: coverage run against the guard recorded in toolchain.md and in the vitest.config.mts comment

FR-031.assumes: the upgrade was performed outside this task list; toolchain.md records the versions and the gate exits that prove it, not a test

intent: Each repository owns a profile of its C#/XAML conventions, initialized and refreshed through AI chat, so the graph reads any repository correctly without editing extension source.

decisions.decision: Chat opens through the workbench command workbench.action.chat.open with a partial query, guarded by commands.getCommands and falling back to the clipboard
decisions.why: The spec needs a conversation the developer steers, and a partial query fills the chat input without sending it, so no extension code calls an inference endpoint
decisions.rejected: The vscode.lm Language Model API: single request and response, no conversation to correct, and the extension would become the caller of a model

decisions.decision: The profile is csharp-xaml-graph.profile.json at the workspace folder root, strict JSON, version 1
decisions.why: The name states its purpose, it is committed at the root, and JSON.parse reads it with no new dependency
decisions.rejected: YAML or JSONC, which both need a parser dependency, and a .vscode location, which is the editor settings folder

decisions.decision: Layer classification becomes an ordered first-match rule list with the current constants as the default rules
decisions.why: Precedence becomes a declared order, and one evaluator serves both the profiled and the unprofiled run
decisions.rejected: Leaving classifyType untouched and branching to a second profiled implementation, which would drift invisibly

decisions.decision: The assistant reply arrives through the clipboard, is parsed and merged, and only then written
decisions.why: It works in every host with no dependency and keeps the refusal path in the extension, so an unusable reply writes nothing
decisions.rejected: Letting the agent write the file directly, which bypasses the refusal, and a single-line input box, which cannot carry a profile

decisions.decision: Merge direction is explicit: a profile replaces built-in defaults, and a refresh unions into the existing file with existing scalars winning
decisions.why: The spec asks for replace against defaults and preservation against refresh, so the two directions must be separate rules
decisions.rejected: One merge rule for both directions, which would either append to defaults or drop declarations on refresh

decisions.decision: Profile problems ride the model existing warnings array and render at the top of the Problems pane, leaving the tab badge on findings
decisions.why: The pane is where a reader looks for what went wrong, and no existing assertion about the badge changes
decisions.rejected: A sixth finding kind, which would change counts the verification plan compares

decisions.decision: Prompt evidence is derived inside analyzeWorkspace from the parsed declarations and carried on the model as an optional profileEvidence field
decisions.why: The analysis has already parsed every file, and call names are the evidence the registration question needs
decisions.rejected: Re-reading and re-parsing the workspace in the prompt builder, or scraping the public model, which loses call names

decisions.decision: A file-system watcher on the profile path invalidates the cached model
decisions.why: An imported or hand-edited profile re-reads in the same session, which is what SC-005 asks
decisions.rejected: Relying on configuration change events, which cannot see a profile edited in the same window

decisions.decision: Generated members become attribute plus naming-form rules, with two forms matching the two generators already understood
decisions.why: A different toolkit moves which attribute generates what without inventing a naming language
decisions.rejected: A general naming-expression mini-language, which nothing in the spec or the code needs

decisions.decision: Layer classification, link names, findings rules and file selection all arrive as one CompiledConventions object built once per analysis
decisions.why: A thousand-file analysis must not re-resolve a profile per node, and one object is what keeps the profiled and unprofiled runs on the same code path
decisions.rejected: Reading the profile inside each analysis module, which would parse it repeatedly and let the modules drift

decisions.decision: The profile carries a closed set of two generated-member naming forms (commandSuffix, pascalCaseWithoutPrefix)
decisions.why: Those are the two generators the analysis understands, and the plan rejected a naming mini-language nothing needs
decisions.rejected: A general naming-expression language in the profile

decisions.decision: Profile problems reach the page as warning strings in a single shared format (profileWarningText / profileProblemNote)
decisions.why: The model already has a warnings array the debug report shows, and one formatter keeps the host and the page from disagreeing
decisions.rejected: A second structured field on the model just for the pane

decisions.decision: The service-locator names are threaded into the C# parser as a parameter with the old two names as its default
decisions.why: A profile that adds a locator name must be seen by the parse, not only filtered afterwards
decisions.rejected: Gating only in the analysis, which could restrict the built-in list but never extend it

decisions.decision: The settings form writes a field only when the reader changed it
decisions.why: Saving include and exclude on every submit would pin the two lists the profile is allowed to choose, because an explicitly configured pattern wins
decisions.rejected: Writing all five keys on every submit, which silently disabled a profile files section

decisions.decision: The profile watcher invalidates on create and delete as well as change
decisions.why: A profile that appears or disappears leaves the cached model describing a file that is not what is on disk
decisions.rejected: Watching only change events

decisions.decision: The import refusal judges the merged profile for content, not for the presence of a section
decisions.why: A section whose every entry was rejected parses to an empty list, which would otherwise be written as a profile that looks authoritative and says nothing
decisions.rejected: Testing whether the parsed profile has a layers, links, findings or files key

decisions.decision: A new headless entry point src/validate.ts, built to out/validate.js, with its pure half in src/graph/validation.ts
decisions.why: FR-018 needs a checkout analysed by location with no editor open, and the analysis already takes compiled conventions from its caller
decisions.rejected: adding profile loading and record comparison to the self-test, which would put two jobs in one large script

decisions.decision: The profile own include and exclude are applied by a small matcher in src/graph/files.ts
decisions.why: the record scope must be the profile own selection, and the baseline counts must be reproduced by the same rules
decisions.rejected: reusing the self-test hardcoded skip list, which would define scope outside the profile under test

decisions.decision: One exhaustive expected-answer record per checkout under specs expected, committed before the first run
decisions.why: the three external checkouts may gain one profile file only, and an omission must not score as accuracy
decisions.rejected: a sample of representative types, or a record stored inside the checkout

decisions.decision: A fresh-context assistant receives the command setup prompt plus the checkout path and may write only the profile file
decisions.why: FR-019 and the fresh-context requirement leave nothing else to hand over, and one prompt definition cannot drift
decisions.rejected: a second headless-only prompt

decisions.decision: The result carries no timestamp and no absolute path, and the determinism comparison excludes the profile hash
decisions.why: two equivalent runs must be byte identical while a fresh profile may differ in text
decisions.rejected: comparing whole result files including the profile identity

decisions.decision: The invariants condition is out/selftest.js run as a child process against the checkout
decisions.why: one recorded verdict covers all five conditions without a second implementation of the invariants
decisions.rejected: extracting the generic checks into a shared module

decisions.decision: Author the profile contract once as a table in src/graph/profileContract.ts, and have every reportUnknownKeys call take its key list from contractKeys(section)
decisions.why: the parser and the prompt then read one list, so a key the prompt does not describe cannot be accepted, which is the whole of FR-024
decisions.rejected: generating the prompt from contracts/profile.schema.json, which is a spec artifact the extension would have to bundle and which the parser would still not read

decisions.decision: Define compatibility as four structural observations (no C#, no XAML, at or above ANALYSIS_FILE_CAP, an fsproj or vbproj or vcxproj) read by one node:fs walk and decided by one pure assessCompatibility function
decisions.why: all four are answerable from paths, so the verdict costs one walk and needs no parse, and the command and the validator cannot disagree because they share the function
decisions.rejected: counting languages by parsing, which answers a question that must be settled before any analysis with a full analysis

decisions.decision: Ask the offer as one showInformationMessage with Start a new specification and Not now, once per folder, treating a dismissed dialog as no; headless callers answer with --request instead
decisions.why: one code path serves a person and a script, and no path blocks waiting for input
decisions.rejected: re-asking on every analysis, which interrupts a person who already declined

decisions.decision: Keep the verdict on model.warnings as one note per reason so it is rendered by the existing Problems block and survives the dialog, a dismissal and a Re-analyse
decisions.why: FR-028 forbids the reason disappearing with the dialog, and warnings are the one channel in this extension that already outlives one
decisions.rejected: a new compatibility field on GraphModel with a second pane renderer for one sentence

decisions.decision: Write the request to the extension own root at update_prompts/<slug>/request.md, generated from the verdict by a CHANGES_FOR_REASON table
decisions.why: the pinned path is relative to the extension repository, a generated table is the only shape where every reason is provably answered by a named change, and the requesting checkout gains nothing
decisions.rejected: writing the request into the requesting repository

decisions.decision: Record each check of the assistant reply in results/<slug>.attempts.json and let --record pass the import condition only when that file holds one clean attempt
decisions.why: SC-011 is about the first reply, and the final result cannot tell a clean first answer from a third answer corrected twice
decisions.rejected: an attempt count written inside the final result, which the same run grades

decisions.decision: the record producer takes types from inspectFolder and links and findings from one fresh analysis of the same checkout
decisions.why: the link and finding rules have exactly one implementation, and re-deriving them in a second pass is the purpose-written reading FR-030 rules out; the producer still never reads a result file and is run before the measured run
decisions.rejected: a hand-written second derivation of links and findings, which is what produced 29 findings where the analysis reports 21

decisions.decision: a declared type named by a XAML x:Class is recorded as a view, ahead of the compiled layer rules
decisions.why: the analysis assigns the view layer from the markup, so a record built from the layer rules alone produced 0 views and 500 models instead of 82 and 418
decisions.rejected: adding a View_ name rule to the built-in profile, which would change the analysis for every repository to fix one record

decisions.decision: the inspection reports the x:Class each XAML file states as a markup fact, and does not turn it into a layer
decisions.why: keeps inspectFolder free of the layer decision T085 forbids while still giving the producer the fact it needs
decisions.rejected: letting inspectFolder assign layers, which would put a second classifier beside the analysis

plan.summary: Extended the plan, research, data model and contracts for User Story 6: one authored profile contract that the parser and both prompts read alike, a structural compatibility verdict issued before any convention question, an offer with a request-file writer, and an attempts record that makes a first-attempt-clean import measurable.
plan.key_finding: The prompt contradiction FR-023 names is structural rather than textual: the parser keeps six separate accepted-key lists while the prompt carries an undescribed JSON example, so the fix has to be one table that both read, not a longer paragraph in the prompt.

tasks.summary: 42 tasks in 7 phases: 2 setup, 12 foundational, 8 for US1, 5 for US2, 4 for US4, 7 for US3, 4 polish; one owner phase per file, waves with explicit joins

specify.summary: Built and proved the inspection surface and the record producer, regenerated all four expected-answer records from it, retired the hand-written derivation, and recorded the toolchain and coverage guard with a full green gate run at 40 files / 1038 tests and 1095 nodes / 4776 edges / 21 findings.

implement.summary: Closed T060 to T065: gate and pane note tests verified green, plus the headless validator with all six modes built, and the independent derivation tool and this repository record for T066.

approach: One table of profile fields in src/graph/profileContract.ts is both the parser accepted-key set and the section both prompts render before their first question; one node:fs walk feeds a pure assessCompatibility function that both the command and out/validate.js call, so an incompatible repository is named by structure before any prompt exists and is offered a generated request file only after an explicit yes. The four-checkout run gains a verdict mode, a request mode and an attempts record, so the first reply importing clean becomes a recorded measurement rather than a claim.
